{{Quote|The problem with this guy is he's a total recluse. He uses proxies at auctions and private courier companies to deliver his purchases.|[[Lane Vizla]]|<ref name="TOR:EotP" />}}
The '''Curator's Bunker''' was a secret storehouse located underneath the [[Bastal Family Farmhouse]] on [[Kessan's Landing]], an island on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], during the [[Third Galactic War]]. This subterranean bunker was inhabited by [[the Curator]], a reclusive [[Collector/Legends|collector]] of [[Droid/Legends|droids]], who used it to store his collection.<ref name="TOR:EotP" />
